categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes cryptographic primitive implementation in src/crypto/sha512.cpp and src/crypto/sha512.h.
categories.rationale: Cleanses cryptographic hash state and buffer on destruction to prevent sensitive data from lingering in memory. This improves the safety and hygiene of cryptographic primitives, though it is defense-in-depth rather than a fix for an active vulnerability.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet by maintainers because CSHA512 handles wallet passphrase key derivation and BIP32 seed material.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet encryption keys and IVs from persisting in process memory after CSHA512 goes out of scope in CCrypter. While beneficial for key hygiene and defense-in-depth, it addresses lingering memory state rather than direct key loss or active exploits.
